_about: Hand-kept facts the analytics name matching cannot work out itself. Every entry wins over the automatic rules and over the model's review decisions.
Names are matched by their normalized form, so punctuation, 'LLP' and capitalization do not matter.
firms.aliases: each list is one firm; the first name is the one shown.
firms.predecessors: firms that merged into or were renamed to the key. They stay separate firms, linked to the successor, so a leaderboard can choose whether to count them.
firms.kinds: force a filer's kind: law_firm, self_represented, organization, government or company.
*.merge / *.keep_apart: pairs to treat as one, or never as one.
